text: Zainab gives Dami a task. On Tasks, she taps Give a task.
She writes what is to be done, and chooses who it is for: Dami.
Tap Give the task. Dami hears it in her chat.
Under Everyone’s, the task is open, for Dami.
On Dami’s phone, the task is waiting. She taps Done when finished.
At the end of her shift, Dami hands it over. Taskiem adds up the shift: ₦86,500 sold in 7 sales.
She counts the cash drawer and types what is there.
₦500 short of the cash sold. Tap Hand over.
